_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/costs/test_variable_energy_payment.py. t_energy_font is Territorial Aetherkite's chosen payment on a tap ability: you may pay one or more {E}, and gain that much life. t_energy_coup is Confiscation Coup's computed one without the energy gain: you may pay {E} equal to the target creature's mana value, and if you do, gain control of it.

cards.name: Test Energy Font
cards.oracle_text: {T}: You may pay one or more {E}. If you do, you gain that much life.

abilities.text: {T}: You may pay one or more {E}. If you do, you gain that much life.

cards.name: Test Energy Coup
cards.oracle_text: Choose target creature. You may pay an amount of {E} equal to its mana value. If you do, gain control of it.
